ancient-records-egypt-breasted-1906-vol-.title: Ancient Records of Egypt, Vol. V: Indices
ancient-records-egypt-breasted-1906-vol-.creator: James Henry Breasted (ed./trans.)
ancient-records-egypt-breasted-1906-vol-.description: Vol. V: Indices of James Henry Breasted's Ancient Records of Egypt (1906) — the foundational English corpus of translated Egyptian historical inscriptions, from the earliest times to the Persian conquest. Public domain. Sourced from Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/ancientrecordsof05brea).

arxiv-2109-06834.title: Dynamics and Structural Transformations of Carbon Onion-Like under High-Velocity Impacts Journal: Elsevier
arxiv-2109-06834.creator: M. L. Pereira Júnior, W. F. da Cunha, R. T. de Sousa Junior, G. D. Amvame Nze, D. S. Galvão, L. A. Ribeiro Júnior
arxiv-2109-06834.description: Abstract Carbon nano-onions (CNO) are multi-shell fullerenes. In the present work, we used fully atomistic reactive (ReaxFF) molecular dynamics simulations to study the dynamics and structural transformations of CNO structures under high-velocity impacts against a fixed and rigid substrate. We considered single and multi-shell CNO (up to six shells) and at different impact velocities (from 2 up to 7 Km/s).

arxiv-2111-10650.title: Simulated LiDAR Repositioning : a novel point cloud data augmentation method
arxiv-2111-10650.creator: Xavier Morin-Duchesne, Michael S. Langer
arxiv-2111-10650.description: Abstract We address a data augmentation problem for LiDAR. Given a LiDAR scan of a scene from some position, how can one simulate new scans of that scene from different, secondary positions? The method defines criteria for selecting valid secondary positions, and then estimates which points from the original point cloud would be acquired by a scanner from these positions.

arxiv-2201-09991.title: Arrow Spaces: An Approach to Inner Product Spaces and Affine Geometry
arxiv-2201-09991.creator: Hussin Albahboh 1 , Harry Gingold 2 and Jocelyn Quaintance 3
arxiv-2201-09991.description: Abstract . Given a postulated set of points, an algebraic system of axioms is proposed for an “arrow space’”. An arrow is defined to be an ordered set of two points ⟨ T , H ⟩ \left<T,H\right> , named respectively Tail and Head. The set of arrows is an arrow space.

arxiv-2208-08250.title: QCD at the Future Circular e + ​ e − \mathrm{e^{+}e^{-}} Collider
arxiv-2208-08250.creator: Eduardo Ploerer 1,2 on behalf of the FCC collaboration
arxiv-2208-08250.description: Abstract The Future Circular Collider in the e + ​ e − \mathrm{e^{+}e^{-}} configuration offers the opportunity to significantly improve SM measurements with dedicated runs at the Z-pole, WW threshold, ZH (240 GeV), and t ​ t ¯ \mathrm{t}\bar{\mathrm{t}} threshold.

arxiv-2308-04637.title: Sparse Binary Transformers for Multivariate Time Series Modeling Conference: Proceedings of the 29th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining; August 6–10, 2023; Long Beach, CA, USA Proceedings of the 29th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD ’23), Au
arxiv-2308-04637.creator: Matt Gorbett, Hossein Shirazi, Indrakshi Ray
arxiv-2308-04637.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Matt Gorbett, Hossein Shirazi, Indrakshi Ray. Compressed Neural Networks have the potential to enable deep learning across new applications and smaller computational environments. However, understanding the range of learning tasks in which such models can succeed is not well studied. In this work, we apply sparse and binary-weighted Transformers to multivariate time series problems, showing that the lightweight models achieve accuracy comparable to that of dense floating-point Transformers of the same structure.

arxiv-2309-06061.title: Verifiable Fairness: Privacy–preserving Computation of Fairness for Machine Learning Systems
arxiv-2309-06061.creator: Ehsan Toreini, Maryam Mehrnezhad, Aad Van Moorsel
arxiv-2309-06061.description: Abstract Fair machine learning is a thriving and vibrant research topic. In this paper, we propose Fairness as a Service (FaaS), a secure, verifiable and privacy-preserving protocol to computes and verify the fairness of any machine learning (ML) model. In the deisgn of FaaS, the data and outcomes are represented through cryptograms to ensure privacy.

arxiv-2310-10262.title: Enhancing Interpretability using Human Similarity Judgements to Prune Word Embeddings
arxiv-2310-10262.creator: Natalia Flechas Manrique, Wanqian Bao, Aurelie Herbelot, Uri Hasson
arxiv-2310-10262.description: Abstract Interpretability methods in NLP aim to provide insights into the semantics underlying specific system architectures. Focusing on word embeddings, we present a supervised-learning method that, for a given domain (e.g., sports, professions), identifies a subset of model features that strongly improve prediction of human similarity judgments.

arxiv-2412-11655.title: Induced gravity and cosmological principle
arxiv-2412-11655.creator: V. A. Berezin, I. D. Ivanova, A. E. Kuprina
arxiv-2412-11655.description: Abstract The phenomenological description of the cosmological particle production in the framework of the induced gravity is investigated. It appears that the source terms with the particle number density in the creation law can be interpreted as the invisible part of the Universe.

arxiv-2506-16076.title: General-domain FC-based shock-dynamics solver I: Basic elements
arxiv-2506-16076.creator: Oscar P. Bruno, Daniel V. Leibovici
arxiv-2506-16076.description: Abstract This contribution, Part I in a two-part article series, presents a general-domain version of the FC-SDNN (Fourier Continuation Shock-detecting Neural Network) spectral scheme for the numerical solution of nonlinear conservation laws, which is applicable under arbitrary boundary conditions and in general domains .

arxiv-2507-11681.title: Finite Pinwheel Scheduling: the k-Visits Problem
arxiv-2507-11681.creator: Sotiris Kanellopoulos, Christos Pergaminelis, Maria Kokkou, Euripides Markou, Aris Pagourtzis
arxiv-2507-11681.description: Abstract Pinwheel Scheduling is a fundamental scheduling problem, in which each task i i is associated with a positive integer d i d_{i} , and the objective is to schedule one task per time slot, ensuring each task perpetually appears at least once in every d i d_{i} time slots.

europmc-pmc8047518.title: mRNA therapeutics in cancer immunotherapy.
europmc-pmc8047518.creator: Beck JD, Reidenbach D, Salomon N, Sahin U, Türeci Ö, Vormehr M, Kranz LM.
europmc-pmc8047518.description: Synthetic mRNA provides a template for the synthesis of any given protein, protein fragment or peptide and lends itself to a broad range of pharmaceutical applications, including different modalities of cancer immunotherapy. With the ease of rapid, large scale Good Manufacturing

pmc-10518391.title: Reduced maternal immunity and vertical transfer of immunity against SARS-CoV-2 variants of concern with COVID-19 exposure or initial vaccination in pregnancy
pmc-10518391.creator: Rupsa C. Boelig, Sidhartha Chaudhury, Gregory D. Gromowski, Sandra Mayer, Jocelyn King, Zubair H. Aghai, Elke Bergmann-Leitner
pmc-10518391.description: IntroductionAs the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic continues to evolve, we face new variants of concern with a concurrent decline in vaccine booster uptake. We aimed to evaluate the difference in immunity gained from the original SARS-CoV-2 mRNA vaccine series in pregnancy versus SARS-CoV-2 exposure during pregnancy against recent variants of concern.

pmc-10562642.title: IL-10 predicts the prognosis of patients with hepatitis B virus-related acute-on-chronic liver failure combined with spontaneous bacterial peritonitis
pmc-10562642.creator: Linxiang Liu, Nanxi Xiao, Peng Chen, Xuan Zhu
pmc-10562642.description: BackgroundSpontaneous bacterial peritonitis (SBP) is common in patients with hepatitis B virus-related acute-on-chronic liver failure (HBV-ACLF). The prognostic value of interleukin-related serum markers for patients with ACLF is coming to the fore. However, there is an unmet need to predict the survival of such patients.

pmc-10598801.title: Neighborhood greenspace and neighborhood income associated with white matter grade worsening: Cardiovascular Health Study
pmc-10598801.creator: Lilah M Besser, Gina S Lovasi, Joyce Jimenez Zambrano, Simone Camacho, Devi Dhanekula, Yvonne L Michael, Parveen Garg, Jana A Hirsch, David Siscovick, Philip M Hurvitz, Mary L Biggs, James E Galvin, Traci M Bartz, W T Longstreth
pmc-10598801.description: INTRODUCTIONWe examined whether a combined measure of neighborhood greenspace and neighborhood median income was associated with white matter hyperintensity (WMH) and ventricle size changes.METHODSThe sample included 1260 cognitively normal ≥ 65‐year‐olds with two magnetic resonance images (MRI; ≈ 5 years apart).

pmc-10617755.title: The effects of repeated doses of xylazine-ketamine and medetomidineketamine anesthesia on DNA damage in the liver and kidney
pmc-10617755.creator: Tunahan Sancak
pmc-10617755.description: Purpose:This study evaluated the DNA damage caused by repeated doses of xylazine-ketamine and medetomidine-ketamine anesthesia in the liver and kidneys.Methods:In this study, 60 rats were used. The rats were divided into group 1 (xylazine-ketamine), and group 2 (medetomidine-ketamine), and these anesthetic combinations were administered to the rats at repeated doses with 30-min intervals.

pmc-11419967.title: Application of Asteraceae biomass and biofertilizers to improve potato crop health by controlling black scurf disease
pmc-11419967.creator: Muhammad Rafiq, Amna Shoaib, Arshad Javaid, Shagufa Parveen, Muhammad Ahmad Hassan, Hafiz Husnain Nawaz, Chunsong Cheng
pmc-11419967.description: Potato (Solanum tuberosum L.) cultivation in Pakistan faces challenges, with black scurf disease caused by Rhizoctonia solani Kühn being a significant concern. Conventional methods like chemical fungicides partially control it, but an effective solution is lacking. This study explores the potential of biofertilizers and soil amendments from Asteraceae weed biomass to manage the disease.

pmc-11434728.title: Application of Hydrophilic Polymers to the Preparation of Prolonged-Release Minitablets with Bromhexine Hydrochloride and Bisoprolol Fumarate
pmc-11434728.creator: Agata Grzejdziak, Witold Brniak, Olaf Lengier, Justyna Anna Żarek, Dziyana Hliabovich, Aleksander Mendyk, Ivana Aleksić, Jelena Djuris
pmc-11434728.description: Minitablets have been extensively studied in recent years as a convenient pediatric form because they allow successful administration even in very young children. Their advantages include easy dose adjustment by multiplication of single units as well as the possibility of drug release modification by coating or forming matrix systems.

pmc-11437220.title: Use of Creative Frameworks in Health Care to Solve Data and Information Problems: Scoping Review
pmc-11437220.creator: Elisabeth Veronica Mess, Frank Kramer, Julia Krumme, Nico Kanelakis, Alexandra Teynor
pmc-11437220.description: BackgroundDigitization is vital for data management, especially in health care. However, problems still hinder health care stakeholders in their daily work while collecting, processing, and providing health data or information. Data are missing, incorrect, cannot be collected, or information is inadequately presented. These problems can be seen as data or information problems.

pmc-11447263.title: Intrusion detection using metaheuristic optimization within IoT/IIoT systems and software of autonomous vehicles
pmc-11447263.creator: Pavle Dakic, Miodrag Zivkovic, Luka Jovanovic, Nebojsa Bacanin, Milos Antonijevic, Jelena Kaljevic, Vladimir Simic
pmc-11447263.description: The integration of IoT systems into automotive vehicles has raised concerns associated with intrusion detection within these systems. Vehicles equipped with a controller area network (CAN) control several systems within a vehicle where disruptions in function can lead to significant malfunctions, injuries, and even loss of life.

pmc-11470867.title: Impact of smokeless tobacco on psychological and oxidative stress in unemployed indian youth
pmc-11470867.creator: Anurag Mishra, Rishabh Kumar, Satya Narayan Mishra, Sivakumar Vijayaraghavalu, Girish C. Shukla, Munish Kumar
pmc-11470867.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In India, tobacco (nicotine) addiction among youth has increased, leading to substantial socioeconomic burdens, mortality, and morbidity. While minimal short-term nicotine consumption may have antioxidant effects, chronic exposure results in various adverse health outcomes. This study examines the impact of chronic nicotine consumption on cellular oxidative stress and psychological stress, and their correlation with Homocysteine (Hcy) levels in unemployed tobacco consumers.

pmc-11580272.title: IROND-L: study protocol for a French prospective, quasi-experimental, multicentre trial to examine the impact of a coordinated multidisciplinary approach for women victims of violence
pmc-11580272.creator: Fabienne El-Khoury, Inès Ben Ghezala, Ghada Hatem, Zohra Jaffal, Andre Soares, Leila Yacini, Sophie Duchesne, Marc Dommergues, Florence Bretelle, Sara Eudeline, Pascale Hoffmann, Claire Masse-Navette, Fanida Layachi, Odile Maurice, Tiphaine de Foucher de Careil, Marc Bardou
pmc-11580272.description: Background and objectivesViolence against women (VAW) is widespread and can have serious physical and mental health consequences, including post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and sleep disorders. Victim-survivors often face barriers in accessing specialised care, highlighting the need for a multidisciplinary response, especially in healthcare settings.

pmc-12655922.title: Environmental Occurrence, Influencing Factors, and Toxic Effects of 6PPD-Q
pmc-12655922.creator: Tengwen Yin, Ying Liang, Yanju Liu, Jia Liu, Xuedong Wang
pmc-12655922.description: The antioxidant N-(1,3-dimethylbutyl)-N′-phenyl-p-phenylenediamine (6PPD) is widely incorporated into tires to extend their service life. However, in the presence of ozone, it is readily transformed into N-(1,3-dimethylbutyl)-N′-phenyl-p-benzoquinone (6PPD-Q). Owing to the large-scale production and widespread utilization of rubber-related products, 6PPD-Q is continuously released into the environment with tire and road wear particles, becoming ubiquitous across multiple environmental compartments.

pmc-12703445.title: Lithium Recycling from Spent NCM523 Cathode and Resynthesis of High‐Nickel Lithium‐Ion Battery Using Recovered Material
pmc-12703445.creator: Jinwon Seo, Hyerin Jeon, Hui‐il Nam, Jinhee Lee, Yong‐Wook Choi, Jinsub Choi
pmc-12703445.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Many approaches to recycle lithium nickel–cobalt–manganese oxide (NCM) cathodes from degraded lithium‐ion batteries (LIBs) have been reported, but they remain challenging due to environmental issues such as pollution or toxic waste. In this study, a sustainable and green approach for lithium recovery and reuse via mechanochemical method based on high‐energy ball milling is employed to extract lithium from spent NCM without high temperature or toxic solution.

pmc-12949342.title: Longitudinal Density and Volume Changes of Periacetabular Cancellous and Cortical Bone
pmc-12949342.creator: Thomas Robertson, Xiangyu Dong, John Abrahams, Bogdan Solomon, Rob Nelissen, Stuart Callary
pmc-12949342.description: Longitudinal structural bone changes within the periacetabular region have potential implications for fracture risk as well implant or arthroplasty fixation within the pelvis. This study presents the first CT‐based longitudinal quantitative measurements of bone density and volume in a total of 235 patients.

pmc-13088901.title: Dual membrane-spanning anti-sigma 2 controls OMV biogenesis and colonization fitness in Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron
pmc-13088901.creator: Evan J. Pardue, Tengfei Zhong, Nichollas E. Scott, Biswanath Jana, Wandy Beatty, Juan C. Ortiz-Marquez, Mohammed Kaplan, Clay Jackson-Litteken, Mario F. Feldman
pmc-13088901.description: Bacteroides spp. are gram-negative, gut commensals that shape the enteric landscape by producing outer membrane vesicles (OMVs) that degrade dietary fibers and traffic immunomodulatory biomolecules. Understanding the mechanism behind OMV biogenesis in Bacteroides spp. is necessary to determine their role in the gut.

pmc-13169958.title: Dual-targeted lipid nanoparticles for TET3 siRNA delivery: nanobiotechnology strategy to remodel tumor immune microenvironment in hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-13169958.creator: Wei Peng, Jin Zhou, Zhiliang Chen, Chengjia Tang, Jia Kuang, Wenke Li, Zhao Yang
pmc-13169958.description: BackgroundHepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is characterized by a highly immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME), where M2-polarized tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) and exhausted CD8+ T cells limit immunotherapy efficacy. However, the upstream epigenetic mechanisms driving these phenotypes remain poorly defined, and effective nanotherapeutic strategies to reverse this immunosuppression are lacking.

pmc-13181769.title: Interface-Induced Concentration Enhancement in Glycine Solutions Investigated Using Surface Plasmon Resonance Spectroscopy and Molecular Dynamics Simulations
pmc-13181769.creator: Ruairidh Mackay, Mozhdeh Mohammadpour, Binoy Paulose Nadappuram, Karen Johnston, Jan Sefcik, King Hang Aaron Lau
pmc-13181769.description: Recent molecular simulations indicate nanoscale heterogeneity at liquid–solution interfaces, which is expected to significantly impact interfacial processes, such as catalysis and nucleation. We investigate the enhancement of glycine concentration in aqueous solutions at solid interfaces using molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and surface plasmon spectroscopy (SPR) measurements.

pmc-13425078.title: Guselkumab treatment of psoriasis results in sustained reduction of systemic inflammatory biomarkers to week 48 in three phase III randomized controlled trials
pmc-13425078.creator: Niamh Kearney, Miriam Zimmermann, Alianu Akawung, Brian Kirby

pmc-13430186.title: Arrhythmic Risk in Carriers of Predicted Deleterious Rare Variants in Dilated and Arrhythmogenic Cardiomyopathy Genes
pmc-13430186.creator: Ilaria Gandin, Andrea Mario Vergani, Michela Carlotta Massi, Alessia Paldino, Martina Setti, Maria Perotto, Marco Merlo, Gianfranco Sinagra, Giulia Barbati, Emanuele Di Angelantonio, Francesca Ieva, Matteo Dal Ferro
pmc-13430186.description: BackgroundIn dilated (DCM) and arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathies (ACM), monogenic variants in causative genes are key prognostic factors. In the general population, the clinical role of these variants remains debated.ObjectivesThis study aimed to determine the association between rare, predicted deleterious variants (PDrV) in DCM- and ACM-associated genes and disease-related outcomes in the general population.

pmc-13565226.title: Integrative Analysis of the Metabolome and Transcriptome Reveals the Mechanism Underlying Differences in Skin Development Between the New Zealand Rabbit and the Rex Rabbit
pmc-13565226.creator: Bohao Zhao, Jiawei Cai, Ziyang Bai, Ting Chen, Aoyun Fan, Xinyu Cao, Yang Chen, Xinsheng Wu
pmc-13565226.description: Simple SummaryThe Rex rabbit is a representative fur-type breed, yet the molecular mechanisms underlying its distinct fur characteristics relative to meat-type rabbit breeds remain incompletely understood. In this study, fur quality traits were evaluated in Rex and New Zealand White rabbits, followed by integrated metabolomic and transcriptomic profiling of dorsal skin tissues.

pmc-13642457.title: Identification of Microbiome Associations with Tacrolimus Pharmacokinetics in Adult Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation Using Population Pharmacokinetic and Machine Learning
pmc-13642457.creator: Moataz E Mohamed, Shen Cheng, Christopher Staley, Armin Rashidi, Najla El Jurdi, Shernan G Holtan, Pamala A Jacobson
pmc-13642457.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeTacrolimus (TAC) is known for its high pharmacokinetic variability which cannot be fully explained by pharmacogenomic (PGx) and clinical variables. We identified gut microbiome associated with TAC pharmacokinetic variability in allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplant (HCT) recipients.MethodsIn this observational study, metagenomic shotgun sequencing was used to analyze stool microbiome collected within ± 10 days from time of first oral TAC trough at steady state.

pmc-13647731.title: Ultrasound-guided platelet-rich plasma myofascial injection for chronic low back pain: a retrospective study
pmc-13647731.creator: YongJia Chen, Ruju Lv, Yannan Sun, Qian Wang
pmc-13647731.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveRetrospective cohort study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of ultrasound-guided myofascial platelet-rich plasma (PRP) injection for myofascial pain syndrome (MPS)–induced chronic low back pain.MethodsFifty-eight patients treated between May and December 2024 received a single ultrasound-guided PRP injection (n = 32) or two weekly normal saline injections (n = 26), and both groups underwent myofascial hydrodissection targeting trigger points in the longissimus lumborum. Pain intensity was assessed via Visual Analog Scale (VAS), functional disability by the Oswestry Disability Index (ODI).
